sections.title: Control, safety and visibility
sections.text: Process automation is what turns a collection of equipment into a plant you can run, protect and see. We design the control philosophy, build and configure the system, and commission it — DCS, PLC, SCADA and safety systems, chosen for the duty rather than the brochure.

sections.title: Five layers, bottom to top

items.title: Field
items.text: Instruments and final elements: transmitters, valves, actuators.

items.title: Control
items.text: PLC, DCS or RTU. Reads, decides, acts.

items.title: Supervisory
items.text: SCADA and HMI. Where a human sees and intervenes.

sections.note: Most specification disputes come from confusing layer two with layer three.

items.title: DCS
items.text: Distributed control for continuous, plant-wide processes.

items.title: PLC
items.text: Fast discrete logic for skids, compressors and packages.

items.title: Brownfield Upgrades
items.text: Upgrades on plants that cannot stop.

sections.title: Specify the protocol, not the brand
sections.text: Good automation keeps you free to choose the best equipment later and avoids lock-in. We help you write a specification that gets comparable, competitive bids.

sections.title: Let's discuss your next project
sections.text: Tell us what you are planning. An engineer will reply, not a sales queue.
